notes: Income-based via ISEE; each public university sets its own maximum and no-tax threshold. National 'no-tax area' (Law 232/2016): full exemption up to ISEE 22,000-30,000; partial reduction above. Typical max contribution 500-4,000 EUR/yr. Non-resident/non-EU students without Italian assets use ISEE parificato; if not submitted, pay the maximum band. Same framework for EU and non-EU (status follows income declaration, not nationality).

notes: ETH Zurich / EPFL. Fee distinction is NOT nationality but where the university-entrance qualification was obtained. 'Simple' fee CHF 730/semester = CHF 1,460/yr (~1,560 EUR) for those who qualified in CH/Liechtenstein. 'Threefold' fee CHF 2,190/semester = CHF 4,380/yr (~4,690 EUR) for students who obtained entrance qualification abroad, from autumn 2025. So most foreign-qualified EU and non-EU students pay the threefold fee. Approx EUR at ~1.07 CHF/EUR.
